intent_en: To illustrate how a company's reputation and performance influence its share value and investor backing.
previous_intent: To illustrate how a company's reputation and performance influence investor confidence and the market value of its shares.
narration_support: If a company has a good reputation, investors will back it. A company with a poor reputation or poor performance will have difficulty selling its shares.
chart_support: A side-by-side comparison of two area charts: the left chart (with a video play icon) shows a rising trend, while the right chart (with a television icon) shows a falling trend, visually contrasting success and failure.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links reputation and performance to investor backing and share sales. The chart supports this by showing a rising graph for a modern media icon (implying good reputation/performance) and a falling graph for a legacy TV icon (implying poor performance), illustrating the financial impact described.
